row:
Red Barn Rabbit Rescue is a nonprofit organization in Oregon committed to the rescue and rehabilitation of domestic rabbits with the hope of finding them safe forever homes. RBRR is dedicated to educating the public on the domestic rabbit with the goal of reducing the number of unwanted, abused, and neglected rabbits.
www.redbarnrabbitrescue.org
